name: com.verifiedx402/directory
title: Verified x402
description: Verified directory of paid x402 APIs for AI agents. Free search, $0.005 ranked picks in USDC.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Rank verified x402 APIs for a task so you can check before paying and decide which x402 API to call. Returns a shortlist (url, price, scores, and latest verification evidence). Only recently verified listings are ranked. This tool does not call the recommended API. On the HTTP transport the call is paid ($0.005 on eip155:8453) via params._meta["x402/payment"]. The stdio process reads the local index and is not charged.

task.description: What the agent needs done, for example 'current weather in Toronto'. Required. Used to decide which x402 API to call.

category.description: Optional catalog category such as weather, extract, inference, or onchain.

network.description: Optional CAIP-2 network filter, for example eip155:8453.

limit.description: How many listings to return (default 5, max 10).

tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Check one public URL before paying: compare a live x402 payment challenge with the catalog entry when one exists, to see if this endpoint is live and priced right.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free, rate-limited catalog search. Results include unverified listings unless you set verified=1. Each result includes verification.status (verified, stale, mismatch, no_402, down, unchecked).

q.description: Text to match against the description or URL.

verified.description: If true, only listings verified in the last 72 hours.

status.description: Exact verification status filter: verified, stale, mismatch, no_402, down, or unchecked.
